[[File:Demon_Savior_Valkorion.jpg|thumb|right|Valkorion claimed to be the Demon Savior.]]
The '''Demon Savior''' was a prophesied figure in the [[Old Ways (Zakuul)|Old Ways]], the religion of the tribal people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]. The Demon Savior was said to be a [[Demon/Legends|Demon]], an outcast who challenged the idea that their fates belonged to the god [[Izax]] and were tied to the will of the gods; however, the Demon Savior was prophesied to be a Demon who would climb beyond Izax's reach&mdash;an "immortal god of gods" who would overthrow the [[Six Gods|Old Gods]] and bring about a new age. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Force entity [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], in his new guise as "Valkorion," claimed to be the Demon Savior of prophecy upon his arrival and began a successful campaign against the Old Ways.<ref name="Old Ways">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Old Ways of Zakuul}}</ref>
